question: ¿Cuáles son los fármacos que actúan sobre HER2 (gen ERBB2) y que se están probando en cáncer de mama en ensayos de fase 3, contando también los de fase 2/3?

attempts.query:
WITH her2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT md.parent_chembl_id AS pid
  FROM chembl.drug_mechanism dm
  JOIN chembl.target_components tc ON tc.target_chembl_id = dm.target_chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON md.chembl_id = dm.chembl_id
  WHERE tc.gene_symbol = 'ERBB2'
), names AS (
  SELECT h.pid, lower(m.pref_name) AS n FROM her2 h JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.parent_chembl_id = h.pid WHERE m.pref_name IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT h.pid, lower(s.synonyms) FROM her2 h JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.parent_chembl_id = h.pid JOIN chembl.molecule_synonyms s ON s.chembl_id = m.chembl_id
), trials AS (
  SELECT s.nct_id FROM aact.studies s
  WHERE s.phase IN ('PHASE3','PHASE2/PHASE3')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions b WHERE b.nct_id = s.nct_id AND b.downcase_mesh_term = 'breast neoplasms')
), tnames AS (
  SELECT i.nct_id, lower(i.name) AS n FROM aact.interventions i JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = i.nct_id
  UNION
  SELECT o.nct_id, lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = o.nct_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name
FROM names n
JOIN tnames t ON t.n ~ ('\m' || regexp_replace(n.n, '([^a-z0-9 ])', '\\\1', 'g') || '\M')
JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON md.chembl_id = n.pid
